notes.title: How do you guys like the Bots?
notes.content: Just wanted to check what you guys think about the bots? and if you're still playing havoc.

notes.title: Added Bots and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Bots has now been added. They are on by default, so all players can play matches while waiting for real players. To disable them, go to lobby settings and disable bots.

Bots are very basic and may be buggy, but at least now you can play matches by yourself.

notes.title: Bug Patches - Lowered Skin unlock time
notes.content:
A couple of bugs have been patched.
Lowered the time to unlock skins from every 2 hours to every 1 hour.

I have a lot going on my mind lately with work, so i have not had time to make any changes to havoc. The way i see it, it might be like this for a while, obviously you guys see how havoc did not release the way we wanted it too. This was our first game and honestly it become a great portfolio piece whether it failed or not. Occasionally i will do some bug fixes if there is anything urgent.

If there is anything you guys want in havoc, that is achievable on my end i don't mind adding it. At this point havoc is more for you guys then me, if i have some extra time i might add something you guys request but don't expect anything quick. Thank you guys for playing our first game.

notes.title: Impersonators / All Skins unlockable and marketable
notes.content:
Hey guys, over the past couple days I've noticed we have had an increase in hackers who are impersonating steam accounts. Many of them have impersonated me and acting like he's the developer. I have not been home for the past 3-4 days so anything you have seen was NOT me.

This patch includes updates to potentially putting a stop to that, along with changing our focus a bit. In the past we had skins only purchasable through the store. Since we realized release did not go as well as we hoped for we decided to make every skin unlockable through playing. Of course rare skins have a much lower chance, but this means you can get any skin, along with being able to market them on the store. The in game store will still be up, but think of that as a way to only support us. We do not care about the revenue anymore and just want you guys to have fun while playing havoc.

Being honest, Ranked or dedicated servers will never come, dedicated servers is well out of our budget, im only 24 and this was my first ever release so i've done alot of things wrong which makes servers much harder to make work. So at this point, we are only focusing on making the game fun and bug free, transitioning more into a casual game, then tactical and strategic.

I hope you guys all understand the reasoning behind this, i plan to make a youtube video to cover everything about the release and what i've learned in the progress.

Thank you guys!

notes.title: Fixed Major Bug with Lobbies, Updated Russian Translation
notes.content:
There has been an ongoing bug with lobbies not being able to join. This seems to be a steam issue where sometimes lobbies are not closed properly leaving some clients inside that lobby. Issue is, those "ghost" lobbies are now showing on lobby list which causes errors for you guys when joining. I have updated this so clients should disconnect properly.

This will take time to correct itself as clients need to close there game in order to leave a ghost lobby. In the mean time, if you try and join a ghost lobby, it will be added to a list which gets excluded from the lobby list.

Updated Russian translation

notes.title: Release Results, Announcement
notes.content:
Hey guys, just wanted to send this message out. Thank you to those who have played and had a good time! For those who haven’t, I’m sorry. Today's release did not go as planned and unfortunately, many of these bugs did not happen during playtesting. This is our first-ever release, and we picked a hard market to start in. So please give us some patience as we are working on fixing as many bugs as possible. We have gotten a lot of bad reviews and I mean it’s bound to happen, but I just want to put it out there that I’ll be working as much as possible to fix the bugs. So just keep reporting them. 

If you guys have any feedback or changes that can make havoc better then put it  in #havoc-forum . We are listening to the community as much as possible. 

We won’t let the bad reviews get to us, at the end of the day we created something we are proud of for our first actual release ever.

notes.title: Release State and News.
notes.content:
Hey everyone, thank you guys so much for all your feedback and help in finding things we can work on. We are sorry a lot of you guys had issues with ranked at start. Unfortunately we are a 2 man team team and don't have the resources to properly test it before release so we were hoping for the best and to be able to fix issues on release.

We are currently fixing as many issues as possible and we plan to continue to take your feedback and change havoc for the community, I understand a lot of you guys are leaving bad reviews based on bugs but please be patient as even AAA games release with a lot of bugs. 

I saw that game skins are overpriced so we will be lowering that. 

We are doing our best so please be patient with us.
